mapper.select: SELECT COURSE_ID as courseId, TITLE as title, DESCRIPTION as description, REGION_ID as regionId, USER_ID as userId, CREATED_AT as createdAt FROM TRAVEL_COURSE ORDER BY COURSE_ID DESC
SELECT COURSE_ID as courseId, TITLE as title, DESCRIPTION as description, REGION_ID as regionId, USER_ID as userId, CREATED_AT as createdAt FROM TRAVEL_COURSE WHERE COURSE_ID = #{id}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TRAVEL_COURSE ( COURSE_ID, TITLE, DESCRIPTION, REGION_ID, USER_ID, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( TRAVEL_COURSE_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{title}, #{description}, #{regionId}, #{userId}, SYSDATE )
